text:
Sam: Need help mapping a Jaeger trace to the Grafana TTFT/tokens panels. trace id: trace-9f8e7d

Maria: Quick pointer: Observability -> Inference -> "TTFT & Tokenflow" dashboard. Grafana permalink: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz789/ttft-tokenflow 

Ben: Panels are arranged by route/model. Left column p50/p95/p99, right side tokens/sec + heatmap. For queries: 
````
# p95 TTFT per route (5m)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

# tokens/sec per model
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model)
````

Sam: Thx. How do I get route/model from the trace?

Ciara: Open Jaeger -> service=runtime -> search trace id. The root span has attributes: route and model labels. Click span -> show tags. Use those to filter dashboard.

Sam: Found route=/v1/chat and model=redwood-14b-q4. P99 spike at ~15:42 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deployment started (canary=true) by @marco at 15:40 UTC :package:

Maria: If a deploy was happening, alerts can be noisy. Which alert fired?

Sam: ttft_p99_high fired at 15:43. I want to avoid noisy alerts from canaries.

Ben: Current alert rule: 
````
alert: TTFT_P99_High
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_ttft_bucket[1m])) by (le, route)) > 1.2
for: 5m
````
Options: increase `for` to 10m, widen the rate window to 5m, or exclude canary traffic.

Ciara: We tag canary requests with `canary=true`. You can exclude canaries in the expression, e.g. add `and (label_join(sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[1m])) by (route, canary), "", "", "") == "")` or simpler filter `canary!="true"` if exporter exposes it.

Maria: Another pragmatic approach: add `suppress_during_deploy: true` in alert description and use mute schedules for deploy windows. For quick fix, bump `for` to 10m.

Sam: I'll open an alert PR: increase `for` to 10m and add `route!~"/internal-canary.*"` to reduce noise. Also will link the trace + grafana permalink in the PR.

Ben: Also check tokens/sec around spike to see if it was a token storm vs slow startup. If tokens/sec is normal and latency high, likely cold-start or runtime warmup.

Sam: tokens/sec was low during the spike. Guessing cold start on the model variant.

Ciara: For postmortem, save: Jaeger span link + Grafana panel permalink + trace id -> add to Confluence page https://confluence.redwood.ai/obs/trace-to-dashboard-mapping. We have a template: fields for trace id, route, model, grafana link, jaeger link, deploy id.

Sam: Great. PR incoming, will paste links and mark as `suppress_during_deploy`. Ping me if you want me to exclude canaries from historical metrics as well.

Maria: Nice. Ping on the PR, I'll review the rule and the mute schedule. :thumbsup:
